ios.desc:
Bookshop.org’s mission is simple: We help local, independent bookstores thrive by giving more than 80% of our profits back to our network of 3,000+ stores. In our app, you can read millions of ebooks - and every purchase supports an independent bookstore near you! 

In the Bookshop app you can:

- Read your ebooks in our customizable ebook reader.
- Browse millions of titles and discover your next favorite read in romance, thrillers, mystery, fiction, non-fiction, memoir, and more.
- Organize your TBR into custom shelves.
- Highlight in five different colors, and add notes to your highlighted passages.
- Sort & filter highlights and notes by date created, book order, and more.
- Save titles to your wishlist so you can read them later.
- Shop knowing that over 80% of the profit goes directly to local, independent bookstores.

We’re a Certified B Corp, and we’ve raised more than $50 million for independent bookstores nationwide since 2020.

Download the Bookshop.org app to support bookstores, not billionaires.
